trash_description: Local: cancels the phantom +4000 'Language: Not English' on dual-audio releases. At grab time Sonarr parses language from the release title; many dual-audio releases (VARYG, ToonsHub, EMBER) parse as Japanese-only and pick up Language: Not English. At import the language comes from the file (JA+EN), the CF drops off, and the release is rejected as 'not a Custom Format upgrade'. This CF fires only when the title says dual-audio AND English is missing from the parsed languages, so it is inactive once the file is imported.
name: Anime Dual Audio Misparsed

specifications.name: Dual Audio (same regex as Anime Dual Audio)
